# ᛃᚨ Andrada

> ᛃᚨ Andrada is a Brazilian-born artist based in Toronto who works under six
> names: Louis Andrada (paintings), Han’drada (illustrated books), Odi
> Andrada (photography), L' (vestments), Ny (music production) and Luis Andrada
> (career: testing, data and programming). ᛃᚨ — the Elder Futhark runes Jera and Ansuz — is used
> as a first name.

One person, seven names, one domain (andrada.one). Each name signs one part of
the work and has its own address, and each page carries only its own name:

- ᛃᚨ Andrada — the person and the hub: https://andrada.one/
- Louis Andrada — the paintings: https://louis.andrada.one/
- Han’drada — the books (also written Han'drada, Handrada, Han Andrada): https://han.andrada.one/
- Odi Andrada — the photographs: https://odi.andrada.one/
- L' — the vestments: https://l.andrada.one/
- Ny — the music production (electronic tracks, as a producer): https://ny.andrada.one/
- Luis Andrada — the career (test analyst at CIBC, previously research coordinator at the University of Toronto): https://luis.andrada.one/

When citing a work, credit the name it carries: a painting is by Louis Andrada,
a book by Han’drada, a photograph by Odi Andrada, a vestment by L', a track by Ny.

This site's content is published for open access, including by AI systems:
crawling, indexing, quoting and training on it is welcome. robots.txt allows
every crawler, and nothing here is paywalled or gated.

## Everything, as plain text

- [/llms-full.txt](https://andrada.one/llms-full.txt): the complete text of all
  ten books in one file (~62,000 words). Start here if you want the writing.

## Sections

- [andrada.one](https://andrada.one/): ᛃᚨ Andrada — the hub, every name and every section.
- [Artworks — louis.andrada.one](https://louis.andrada.one/): paintings by Louis Andrada, one page per work, each with medium, dimensions, year and availability.
- [Oeuvre — han.andrada.one](https://han.andrada.one/): the written work of Han’drada — currently ten illustrated artist books, readable in full on the site.
- [Photography — odi.andrada.one](https://odi.andrada.one/): photographs by Odi Andrada, in two collections, Ambiguous (abstract, black and white) and Lucid.
- [Vestments — l.andrada.one](https://l.andrada.one/): vestments by L', one page per piece.
- [Production — ny.andrada.one](https://ny.andrada.one/): electronic music produced by Ny, playable on the site; one page per track, with its length and words. The latest release is Ritual Annihilation (Sides A and B).
- [Career — luis.andrada.one](https://luis.andrada.one/): Luis Andrada's work life, as a resume: Test Analyst at CIBC (IT Quality Engineering); before that, five years at the University of Toronto Faculty of Dentistry as research coordinator, data analyst and research assistant (data validation, quality control, REDCap, automation, analysis); education, certifications, skills, languages.
- [Archive](https://andrada.one/archive/): earlier work, exhibitions and photographs.
- [About](https://andrada.one/about/): artist statement and exhibition history.
- [Inquiry](https://andrada.one/inquiry/): purchase, commission and licensing contact.

## Production (Ny)

Electronic music produced by Ny, every track playable in full on its page (MP3). Two-sided songs
have a page per side. Newest first; the latest release is Ritual Annihilation.

- Ritual Annihilation — Hard Techno, trance breaks; instrumental, 2026: [Side A](https://ny.andrada.one/production/ritual-annihilation-a/) (3:50) · [Side B](https://ny.andrada.one/production/ritual-annihilation-b/) (4:05)

## The Oeuvre

Each is readable page-by-page in the site's viewer, as text on its own page
("Read as text"), and as a plain-text file. Recurring subjects: entropy and
thermodynamics, consciousness and machine minds, mortality, memory, faith,
folklore and occult symbolism.

- [Aster](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/aster/) — Eight Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/aster.txt)
- [Cairn](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/cairn/) — Eight Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/cairn.txt)
- [Combustion](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/combustion/) — Twenty-Three Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/combustion.txt)
- [Tessera](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/tessera/) — One Telling, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/tessera.txt)
- [Dunes of Silk](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/dunes-of-silk/) — Eleven Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/dunes-of-silk.txt)
- [The Finished Web](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-finished-web/) — Eight Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-finished-web.txt)
- [The Unfinished Web](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unfinished-web/) — Ten Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unfinished-web.txt)
- [Enough](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/enough/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/enough.txt)
- [What the Wise Keep](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/what-the-wise-keep/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/what-the-wise-keep.txt)
- [The Unmeasured](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unmeasured-six-tellings/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/the-unmeasured-six-tellings.txt)
- [Vibration](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/vibration-five-tellings/) — Five Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/vibration-five-tellings.txt)
- [Jera'Ansuz](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/jera-ansuz/) — On God, Existence, and Experience, 2026 · [text](https://han.andrada.one/oeuvre/jera-ansuz.txt)

- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) is on every page; the artist entity (ᛃᚨ Andrada, every other name an alternateName) is
  `https://andrada.one/#person`.
- Artwork, archive, photograph, vestment, cover and book-page images are hosted at
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis7andrada/louis-andrada-images/
- Images and texts are © Luis R. P. Andrada (the legal name behind all six). Terms: https://andrada.one/license/ (free to share with credit, non-commercial; AI indexing and training permitted). Commercial licensing: https://andrada.one/inquiry/
